name: RWJ-394674
summary: RWJ-394674 is a drug that is used in scientific research. It is a potent, orally active analgesic drug that produces little respiratory depression.24 nM at δ and 72 nM at μ.7 nM at δ).

pharmacology.text: RWJ-394674 itself is a potent and selective agonist for δ-opioid receptors, with a Ki of 0.24 nM at δ and 72 nM at μ.

uses.text: RWJ-394674 is a drug that is used in scientific research.

fact.en: RWJ-394674 is a prodrug: the body turns it into a compound that acts on mu-opioid receptors, while the drug itself acts on delta receptors. Researchers used that pairing to look for pain relief with less effect on breathing.
fact.zh: RWJ-394674 是前驅藥：體內會把它轉變成作用於 μ 鴉片受體的化合物，而它本身則作用於 δ 受體。研究人員利用這種搭配，尋找止痛而較少影響呼吸的方式。
fact.zhHans: RWJ-394674 是前驱药：体内会把它转变成作用于 μ 鸦片受体的化合物，而它本身则作用于 δ 受体。研究人员利用这种搭配，寻找止痛而较少影响呼吸的方式。
